zh: 雨夜。江湖追殺令一出，天下人都在找燕飛霜。
凌大俠，你不必陪我。我一個人，比較好躲。
……你這個人，說話一點都不好聽。
呼……總算找到兩位了！血蓮的人往這邊來了，四個，個個帶刀！
這個嘛……江湖消息，我錢不二最通。十兩，這次算你們便宜。
多謝惠顧！往西走，別回頭！
竹林西邊，三棵斷竹那裡。剛剛才走過去。
我錢不二做生意，最講信用！一百兩，童叟無欺。
嘿嘿。做生意嘛，兩邊收錢，才叫生意。
……只是，往西走的人，跟往西追的人，碰在一起會怎樣？我可就不管了。
燕飛霜！交出劍譜，留妳全屍！
每次都是這句話，你們血蓮就不能換一句嗎？
他不說話。他從來不說話。
一枚玉牌……上面刻的是，蓮花？
蓮心小築。是洛無塵的人。
走吧。至少今夜，那裡比竹林安全。
兩位，雨夜辛苦了。孤鴻，多謝。
洛先生，你為什麼要救我？大會上，人人都說我是兇手。
人人都說的，不一定是真的。燕姑娘，劍譜，可否借無塵一觀？
果然。這不是一本完整的書。
世人只知道天劍譜，卻不知道，它只是天機策的一半。
另一半，叫地機卷。一卷記劍，一卷記謀。合在一起，能算盡天下每一步棋。
二十年前，被一個人偷走了。一個……沒有人見過他真面目的人。
洛先生，慧明的死，你看出了什麼？
那具屍首，唇不黑，指不青，身上沒有一點中毒的痕跡。
而且，冷得太快了。快得……不像一個剛死的人。
死在龍淵閣的，也許根本不是慧明。
那會是誰？誰能在三教眼前，扮成另一個人？
能讓三教都看不出破綻的人，天下，只有一個。
我在想，那個慧明……如果死的不是他，那真正的慧明，又在哪裡？
也許，早就不在這世上了。
我師父臨死前，把劍譜交給我。她說，守住它，就是守住天下。
可是我現在連自己都守不住。
妳守著劍譜，我守著妳。這樣，就夠了。
……你這個人，總算說了一句好聽的話。
池上的月光很靜。可是靜的地方，往往藏著最多的聲音。
錢不二！燕飛霜往哪裡跑了？
魏、魏大俠！這個消息，可是很貴的……
一百……十兩！十兩就好！她往蓮心小築去了！
洛無塵那裡？哼，我就知道。
你就是那個不說話的劍客？讓開。
替我告訴洛無塵：燕飛霜的事，我不管了。可他欠我的那一戰，我一定要討回來。
殷兄，追殺令發得這麼快，你就這麼肯定，是燕丫頭下的毒？
酒杯從她的席上傳出，人證物證俱在。道長以為呢？
貧道以為，一個要下毒的人，不會笨到用自己的杯子。
也許，她正是要讓人這麼想。
哈哈……殷兄，你想得真遠。遠得，連貧道都跟不上了。
天下大事，不能不想得遠一些。道長，再飲一杯？
不了。殷兄這壺酒，最近……越來越難喝了。
殷閣主召喚，本王豈敢不來。
你答應過九霄的地機卷，在哪裡？
等天劍譜到了閣主手中，地機卷，自然雙手奉上。
燕飛霜逃了。洛無塵已經起了疑心。
洛無塵聰明，聰明人最喜歡什麼？最喜歡懷疑。
那就給他更多可以懷疑的東西。比如……萬佛峰的那位老和尚。
本王的臉，可以是任何人的臉。
……好。三教若是自己先亂了，天劍譜，就沒有人守得住。
還有一件事。萬佛峰上封劍譜的三道封印，閣主可準備好了？
儒門的封印，在九霄手裡。道門、佛門的，九霄自有辦法。
三道封印合一，天下就再也沒有人能阻止閣主了。
（鏡王啊鏡王。等兩卷都到了九霄手裡……你，也就沒用了。）
十兩……一百兩……嘿嘿，今晚的生意，真是不錯！
啊！啞……啞劍大俠！我、我什麼都沒說！
好好好，我說！血蓮那邊……是我告訴他們的。可是我也告訴凌少俠了啊！
兩邊都知道，那就是……公平！對不對？
……我的袖子！我只有這一件衣服啊！
呼……下次，兩邊收錢，要收三倍。
一個不說話的劍客，一個說太多話的小人。
可是誰也沒有想到，下一個找上門來的，是一個只愛看熱鬧的人。
en: A night of rain. Since the warrant went out, the whole world is looking for Yan Feishuang.
Master Ling, you don’t have to stay with me. Alone, I can hide more easily.
Alone, you can be killed more easily too.
...You really don’t know how to say anything nicely.
Nice words have never saved anyone.
Phew — found you at last! The Blood Lotus are coming this way. Four of them, all with blades!
Well now... nobody knows the news of the world like Qian Bu’er. Ten taels — a bargain, this time.
Thank you kindly! Go west, and don’t look back!
West of here, by the three broken bamboos. She just went that way.
If you are lying to us...
I, Qian Bu’er, am the most honest man in business! A hundred taels — fair to young and old.
Hee hee. That’s business: you get paid by both sides, or it isn’t business at all.
...Of course, what happens when the ones going west meet the ones chasing west — that’s not my concern.
There’s the smell of blades in the rain.
Yan Feishuang! Hand over the manual and we’ll leave your body whole!
Always the same line. Can’t the Blood Lotus think of anything new?
All together! Kill the woman first!
The lone goose flies by, and no one asks its name;
one stroke at the throat, and not a sound.
Who are you? Give us your name!
He did not speak. He never speaks.
A Single Line of the Lone Goose!
A Single Line of the Lone Goose.
A Single Line of the Lone Goose!
My thanks for your help. And you are...?
A jade token... with a lotus carved on it?
The Lotus Heart Retreat. He is Luo Wuchen’s man.
He wants us to follow him?
Come. Tonight, at least, it is safer than the bamboo.
You two had a hard night in the rain. Gu Hong — thank you.
Master Luo, why save me? At the council, everyone said I was the murderer.
What everyone says is not always true. Miss Yan — might Wuchen see the manual?
Just as I thought. This is not a whole book.
The world knows of the Heavenly Sword Manual, but not that it is only half of the Celestial Stratagem.
The other half is the Earthly Scroll. One records the sword, the other strategy. Together, they foresee every move under heaven.
And where is the Earthly Scroll?
Twenty years ago it was stolen. By a man... whose true face no one has ever seen.
Master Luo, what did you see in Huiming’s death?
That body — the lips were not black, the nails not blue. Not one sign of poison.
And it grew cold too fast. Too fast... for a man who had only just died.
The one who died in the Pavilion may not have been Huiming at all.
Then who? Who could pass for another man under the eyes of the Three Teachings?
Only one man under heaven could fool all three of them.
I keep thinking about Huiming... If it wasn’t him who died, then where is the real Huiming?
Perhaps no longer in this world at all.
My master gave me the manual as she was dying. She said: keep it safe, and you keep the world safe.
But now I can’t even keep myself safe.
You keep the manual. I’ll keep you. That will be enough.
...So you can say something nice after all.
The moonlight on the pond was still. But it is in the still places that the most sounds hide.
Qian Bu’er! Which way did Yan Feishuang run?
Master — Master Wei! That news is very expensive...
A hundred... ten! Ten will do! She went to the Lotus Heart Retreat!
To Luo Wuchen’s? Hmph. I knew it.
(Paid by three sides... what a day for business.)
So you’re the swordsman who doesn’t talk? Out of my way.
You won’t? Good. That suits me fine!
...A fine sword. You’re faster than Ling Yunxiao.
Tell Luo Wuchen this: I’ll leave Yan Feishuang alone. But the fight he owes me — I will have it.
Brother Yin, you sent out that warrant very quickly. Are you so sure the Yan girl poisoned him?
The cup came from her table. There are witnesses, and there is the cup. What does the Master think?
I think that someone who meant to poison a man would not be fool enough to use her own cup.
Perhaps that is exactly what she wants us to think.
Ha ha... Brother Yin, you think a long way ahead. So far that even I can’t keep up.
Great matters demand that one think ahead. Another cup, Master?
No. Brother Yin’s wine has lately... grown harder and harder to swallow.
When the Pavilion Master calls, how could this king not come?
The Earthly Scroll you promised me — where is it?
When the Heavenly Sword Manual is in your hands, the Earthly Scroll will be given to you with both of mine.
Yan Feishuang has escaped. And Luo Wuchen has begun to suspect.
Luo Wuchen is clever. And what do clever men love most? Suspicion.
So give him more to suspect. For instance... that old monk on the Peak.
You would put it on the Buddha Wuya?
This king’s face can be anyone’s face.
...Very well. If the Three Teachings fall on each other first, no one will be left to guard the manual.
One thing more. The three seals that will close the manual on the Peak — is the Pavilion Master ready for them?
The Confucian seal is in my hand. The Taoist and the Buddhist — I have my ways.
With all three seals together, no one under heaven could stop the Pavilion Master.
(Mirror King, Mirror King. Once both halves are in my hands... you will be of no further use.)
Ten taels... a hundred... hee hee, a fine night’s business!
Ah! The — the Mute Sword! I didn’t say anything!
All right, all right, I’ll talk! The Blood Lotus... yes, I told them. But I told Master Ling too!
Both sides knew, so it was... fair! Wasn’t it?
...My sleeve! This is the only robe I own!
Phew... next time, I charge both sides triple.
A swordsman who never speaks, and a little man who speaks far too much.
But no one guessed that the next to come calling would be a man who loves nothing more than a show.
